name: Direct import source order determines compatible extension replacement

input.fixture_ref: Compile two consumers with the same compatible extension imports in opposite source orders while varying filesystem and hash iteration order.

applicability.reason: Requires import-order-dependent selection between two competing extensions. Import scope is now enforced, but nothing selects between two implementations contributing one member; both simply publish.

expect.status: Each consumer selects the implementation from its later direct import regardless of filesystem, scheduler, name sort or map order.
